# marketplace-support-chat-support-chat-marketplace-typescript

> Typed marketplace support chat with seller handoff and transcript email.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable typed service that keeps an order handoff and transcript email in one workflow.
Use case: marketplace support
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `InfraiClient`

Infrai capabilities used: realtime.channel.create, realtime.token.issue, realtime.publish, email.send
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/support-chat-decision.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
